Coram : UDAY UMESH LALIT*, S. RAVINDRA BHAT, PAMIDIGHANTAM SRI NARASIMHA
Penal Code, 1860 – s. 302 r/w s.149, s.307 r/w s.149 and s.148 – Arms Act, 1959 – ss.25 and 30 – Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 – s.293 – Murder of five persons – Seven accused – The deceased belonged to or were associated with two of them were brothers, the third was their minor son and the other two were their close family friends – Trial Court acquitted all the accused – Appeal against acquittal – High Court reversed the findings of the trial court and convicted all the accused under ss.148, 302
Decision Date : 04-11-2022 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 946/2019 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 3 Judges
